SECTOR 7 POWER PLANT REPORT: MINOR INCIDENT CONTAINED

A small technical fault at Sector 7 caused a temporary pressure release. Claims of dangerous radiation are unverified rumors, and spreading panic remains illegal under emergency code. Light atmospheric haze poses no threat, and daily operations continue as normal.
ALL RESIDENTS MUST COMPLY WITH CHECKPOINT INSPECTION.

"MUTATION" CLAIMS DISPROVED: LOCAL CITIZENS REPORT NORMAL HEALTH

Deformity rumors are false propaganda. "I feel completely fine, even better then before" says local resident Otar. Minor facial changes remain well within approved health limits. Spreading physical panic remains illegal.
AVOIDING CHECKPOINT INSPECTION IS PUNISHABLE BY LAW.

MONSTER SIGHTINGS ARE JUST HYSTERIA: TAKE OUR FUN CITIZEN QUIZ!

Hysterical claims of "creatures" roaming Saplavi are absurd. To remind confused citizens of basic biology, try our fun quiz: Can You Spot the Real Human? All faces above display completely standard features approved by state guidelines. Stop letting wild imagination ruin your workday.
AVOIDING CHECKPOINT INSPECTION IS AN ACT OF TREASON; EVADERS WILL BE SHOT ON SIGHT.

ROUTINE HEALTH CHECKS UNDERWAY: JOIN US FOR THE MUNICIPAL FESTIVAL!

Authorities are conducting door-to-door inspections to clear up remaining isolated health incidents. To celebrate regional stability, famous clown Ocho will host tonight's town gathering. "You mourned, cried, and died, now it is time to laugh!" Ocho says.
